# Risk Review Checklist: Lead Distribution Platform

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review across the four selected risk areas — concurrency/data-integrity (deepest), privacy/security, observability/traces, and UX state coverage. Every item tests the WRITTEN requirements (spec/plan/tasks) for completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage — NOT the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-25
**Feature**: specs/001-lead-distribution-platform/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Concurrency & Data Integrity (deepest coverage)

- [x] CHK001 - Does FR-011 pin down duplicate-detection TIMING precisely enough to distinguish capture-time rejection from assignment-time marking for the same email submitted twice sequentially? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 - Is "assigned to a broker at most once ever" scoped to platform lifetime explicitly, including whether any admin action (form reset, purge) could ever reset duplicate state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011/Data Model INV-3]
- [x] CHK003 - Do SC-003/SC-004 enumerate which interleavings must be tolerated (same-email race vs cap-contention race) with the EXACT expected outcome distribution, so the numbers are objectively checkable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003/SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the outcome specified when cap contention exhausts every re-selection attempt mid-routing — is UNSENT vs FAILED vs exception named as the required terminal state? [Gap, Spec §FR-018/FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 - Are recovery requirements defined for a worker crash BETWEEN outbox claim and Lead update (stale-claim reclaim window, double-processing risk)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK006 - Is idempotent redelivery (FR-021) specified at message-identity level (same outbox row replayed) or semantic level (any message about the same lead), so implementers cannot diverge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK007 - Does FR-018 state the guarantee in observable terms (a cap value that can never be observed exceeded) rather than prescribing a mechanism, leaving enforcement design free but verifiable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]

## Privacy & Security

- [x] CHK008 - Is IP-address lifetime explicitly tied to the 90-day purge schedule, and are display/masking rules for IPs defined anywhere they are shown to admins? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/FR-036]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): add one sentence to FR-010/FR-036 — IPs render unmasked in admin-only views and expire with their lead row at purge time.
- [x] CHK009 - Are requirements stated for WHICH log surfaces must mask emails and which (if any) may carry full addresses for support workflows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK010 - Is honeypot-fill behavior fully specified (silent drop vs rate-limit accounting vs logging) so bots receive indistinguishable responses by requirement, not by accident? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): specify honeypot-fill handling in FR-012 — silently dropped (uniform confirmation), and state whether it consumes rate-limit budget.
- [x] CHK011 - Are requirements defined for internal-token lifecycle (rotation, compromise response) or is static shared secret assumed acceptable forever? [Gap, Spec §Security]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): add internal-token lifecycle note (static shared secret accepted for single-server scope; rotation procedure documented in ops README).
- [x] CHK012 - Is FR-034 ("no real credential in version history") phrased so a reviewer can objectively verify compliance (mandated example files, prohibited patterns)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-034]

## Observability & Decision Transparency

- [x] CHK013 - Does FR-019 enumerate the COMPLETE closed set of broker-exclusion reasons (e.g., inactive, off_day, closed, capped, zero_pct) so any persisted trace is interpretable without source access? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK014 - Is end-to-end trace propagation (edge → backend → worker → rows/logs) REQUIRED as an invariant rather than implied, so SC-009 life-reconstruction is guaranteed achievable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032/SC-009]
- [x] CHK015 - Are structured-log retention/rotation parameters carried in requirements (or explicitly delegated to plan) so ops expectations are unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032/plan §D6]
- [x] CHK016 - Does the spec define the MINIMUM event set per lead lifecycle sufficient to debug a "missing" lead (captured, routed/duplicate/unsent/failed, timestamps)? [Gap, Spec §FR-032]

## UX State Coverage

- [x] CHK017 - Are the four required view states (loading/empty/success/error) defined PER VIEW or as a platform-wide rule, and is either reading self-consistent across FR-025/FR-026/FR-028/FR-029? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the ≠100% share warning (FR-014) specified as blocking or non-blocking for saving, with the exact threshold at which the warning appears? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK019 - Are error-state RECOVERY affordances specified for admin views (what the user can DO from an error state), or only that errors must be displayed? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): extend FR-027 — every error state must expose at least one recovery affordance (retry control or navigation link).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for concurrent ADMIN configuration edits (two sessions mutating brokers/membership simultaneously) — last-write-wins accepted, or guarded? [Gap, Spec §US1]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): state the concurrency stance for admin configuration writes (last-write-wins accepted for single-admin scope, or guard mutations on a config-version precondition).
- [x] CHK021 - Does the spec specify how membership views behave when a distribution references a deactivated or deleted broker (display, routing skip, orphan cleanup)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): define broker-delete-vs-membership — either refuse deletion while the broker is a distribution member, or cascade-remove the membership row.
- [x] CHK022 - Is administrator re-provisioning defined if seeded credentials are lost (env-only reseeding, password reset path)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK023 - Are upper bounds specified for lead-list pages (maximum page size, maximum filter range) so FR-026 cannot be satisfied with an unbounded query? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK024 - Is "observe updated data immediately" (FR-033) quantified — next navigation, next render, or a time bound — such that a reviewer can pass/fail it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK025 - Is "live open/closed state" (FR-029) given a refresh cadence or staleness bound, or is "live" left undefined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK026 - Do FR-013 and FR-020 use ONE consistent terminal vocabulary for unroutable leads (UNSENT with reason) versus genuinely failed deliveries (FAILED), with no overlapping definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013/FR-020]
- [x] CHK027 - Does the spec explain the interplay between the shared denominator day (distribution timezone, FR-015) and per-broker cap days (broker timezone, FR-016) clearly enough that cross-timezone behavior near midnight is deterministic? [Consistency/Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015/FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK028 - Can SC-002 ("99% of capturable leads") be measured as written — is the denominator (what makes a lead "capturable") operationally defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK029 - Can SC-012 (admin page renders < 1s) be objectively verified given whether target hardware/environment is specified anywhere? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): pin SC-012 to the calibrated reference environment in Assumptions, or accept the S12 relative budget gates as the verification method.

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK030 - Are DST transitions (spring-forward gap, fall-back overlap) addressed in requirements for working-hour windows so broker eligibility stays well-defined on transition days? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Are overnight windows (close ≤ open) combined with cap-day rollover specified — which day owns a lead assigned at 00:05 in the broker's zone? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 - Is behavior specified for clock discontinuities (NTP corrections, manual change) affecting "sent today" counters and heartbeat age? [Gap]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): document clock-discontinuity stance (NTP slew assumed; monotonic counters unaffected) or add a heartbeat-age clamp requirement.
- [x] CHK033 - Are partial-failure requirements defined for the nightly purge (batch delete fails midway) — resume semantics, partial-state acceptability? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK034 - Is slug-generation retry bounded in requirements (reserved-word + collision retries) with defined failure when the bound exhausts? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): bound slug-collision retries in FR-007 and name the surfaced error when the bound exhausts.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 - Is the single-server deployment assumption (FR-035) reconciled with restart-volatile in-memory state (rate-limit windows, metric registry) — is data-loss-on-restart acceptable-and-documented? [Assumption, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK036 - Is the database dependency pinned to a documented capability level (row locking / conditional-update semantics the guarantees rely on)? [Dependency, plan §tech-stack]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK037 - Are accessibility requirements defined for the PUBLIC intake form (the one anonymous-facing surface), e.g., labels, error announcement, keyboard operability? [Gap, NFR]
> Resolved — spec amended (2026-08-25): add baseline a11y requirements for the public intake form (labelled inputs, keyboard operability, announced validation) despite the desktop-first assumption.
- [x] CHK038 - Is a capture→assignment latency expectation stated anywhere (how long may a lead legitimately sit UNSENT before an operator should worry), or is routing latency entirely unspecified? [Gap, NFR]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline; link findings to the spec section they concern
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
